sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《Dealbook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 Dealbook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at NYTimes.com on November
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 NYTimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻报道的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今日话题。

sentences.en: To rescue the American economy, Congress is on the verge of adopting the most expensive stimulus bill in U.S.
sentences.zh: 为了拯救美国经济，国会即将通过美国历史上最昂贵的经济刺激法案。

sentences.en: history.
sentences.zh: 历史。

sentences.en: Julie Davis on how much the battle over that bill is being shaped by the last financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 朱莉·戴维斯将讲述关于该法案的博弈在多大程度上受到了上一次金融危机的影响。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, March 26th.
sentences.zh: 今天是3月26日，星期四。

sentences.en: Breaking news tonight, the coronavirus forcing millions more Americans into virtual lockdown.
sentences.zh: 今晚突发新闻，新冠疫情迫使数百万美国人进入事实上的封锁状态。

sentences.en: We're pressing the pause button on the American economy.
sentences.zh: 我们正在按下美国经济的暂停键。

sentences.en: We've never done that before.
sentences.zh: 我们以前从未这样做过。

sentences.en: Unemployment could reach 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 失业率可能达到20%。

sentences.en: We've seen huge drops in business for the airlines, hotel.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到航空公司和酒店的业务大幅下滑。

sentences.en: Majority leader Mitch McConnell has canceled the Senate's recess.
sentences.zh: 多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔已经取消了参议院的休会。

sentences.en: The Senate will instead stay in Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 参议院将留在华盛顿特区，

sentences.en: to work on legislation in response to the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 以制定应对新冠疫情的立法。

sentences.en: Lawmakers could send President Trump an emergency spending bill today.
sentences.zh: 议员们今天可能会向特朗普总统提交一份紧急支出法案。

sentences.en: The concern is, are they just going to help the big guys again?
sentences.zh: 人们担心的是，他们是不是又要去救助那些大公司了？

sentences.en: So, Julie, we have talked on the show about how the White House is approaching this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，我们在节目中讨论过白宫是如何应对这场大流行的。

sentences.en: So, now we want to turn to Congress.
sentences.zh: 现在我们想转向国会。

sentences.en: How would you describe Congress's approach to this pandemic?
sentences.zh: 你会如何描述国会应对这场大流行的方式？

sentences.en: So, Congress's chief role in this is that they control the purse strings.
sentences.zh: 国会在此事中的主要角色是控制财政大权。

sentences.en: They control federal money.
sentences.zh: 他们控制着联邦资金。

sentences.en: And they sort of went into this in a lot of ways the way most Americans did, not actually recognizing that the response was going to have to be quite as large as it's turned
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，他们最初的反应和大多数美国人一样，并没有真正意识到这场应对行动需要达到后来所呈现出的那种规模。

sentences.en: out to have been.
sentences.zh: 结果就是，他们现在基本上已经通过了三项重大立法，以便将资金输送到需要的地方，不仅是为了应对公共卫生危机本身，也是为了应对随之而来的巨大经济破坏。

sentences.en: And it ended up that they have basically passed now three pieces of major legislation to be able to get money to where it needs to go to respond to not just the public
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: health crisis itself, but also the huge economic devastation that has followed.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们谈谈这三项主导了国会应对大流行措施的立法。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, let's talk about these three pieces of legislation that have dominated
sentences.zh: 让我们从几周前的第一项法案开始说起。

sentences.en: Congress's response to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 国会的应对措施。

sentences.en: Let's start with the first one from a few weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 让我们从几周前的第一项法案开始说起。

sentences.en: So, the first thing that Congress decides that it needs to do is just get more resources, get more money to the federal agencies that are on the front lines of this.
sentences.zh: 国会决定要做的第一件事就是获取更多资源，为处于抗疫前线的联邦机构提供更多资金。

sentences.en: The Department of Health and Human Services, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, some of the agencies that are dealing
sentences.zh: 卫生与公众服务部、疾病控制与预防中心，以及一些正在处理

sentences.en: with, you know, vaccine development and testing and all of the issues that we're now hearing about that are so important.
sentences.zh: 疫苗研发、检测以及我们现在所听到的所有至关重要的问题的机构。

sentences.en: So, they drafted what at the time seemed a couple of weeks ago like a huge appropriations bill that would send $8.3 billion to those agencies just to kind of get them to the
sentences.zh: 因此，他们在几周前起草了一项在当时看来规模巨大的拨款法案，将83亿美元拨给这些机构，只是为了让他们能够达到足以支持所有额外工作和研究的程度，以应对新冠病毒。

sentences.en: point where they could be supporting all of this extra work, all this extra research that they would need to respond to the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 以应对新冠病毒。

sentences.en: So, the first piece of legislation is just kind of basic funding of the operations required to get through the crisis.
sentences.zh: 所以，第一项立法只是为度过危机所需的运营提供基本资金。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so, the bill itself passes on March 6th.
sentences.zh: 该法案于3月6日通过。

sentences.en: And what does Congress tackle after this initial bill?
sentences.zh: 那么在最初的这项法案之后，国会又处理了什么？

sentences.en: What's the second piece of legislation?
sentences.zh: 第二项立法是什么？

sentences.en: So, the second package of legislation in general was supposed to deal with what very quickly became
sentences.zh: 第二项立法方案总体上是为了解决一个很快变得显而易见的问题，即伴随公共卫生危机而来的真正的经济危机。

sentences.en: clear was just a real economic crisis that was accompanying the public health crisis.
sentences.zh: 这首先与让人们能够获得免费的疾病检测有关，同样重要的是，为那些被告知不应上班的人、失业的人，以及不得不请假照顾家人或因学校停课而照顾孩子的人提供带薪休假。

sentences.en: And that had to do with, first of all, getting people access to free testing for this disease, but also, importantly, paid leave
sentences.zh: 这首先与让人们能够获得免费的疾病检测有关，同样重要的是，为那些被告知不应上班的人、失业的人，

sentences.en: for people who were being told they shouldn't come to work, for people who were losing jobs, for people
sentences.zh: 以及不得不请假照顾家人或因学校停课而照顾孩子的人提供带薪休假。

sentences.en: who were having to take time off to care for family members or for children who were out of school.
sentences.zh: 以及不得不请假照顾家人或因学校停课而照顾孩子的人提供带薪休假。

sentences.en: The American people expect and deserve a coordinated, science-based, and whole-of-government response to keep them and their loved ones safe.
sentences.zh: 美国人民期望并理应得到协调一致、基于科学且举国一致的应对措施，以保障他们及其亲人的安全。

sentences.en: A response that puts families first to stimulate the economy.
sentences.zh: 一项将家庭放在首位以刺激经济的应对措施。

sentences.en: And so, Nancy Pelosi, the Speaker of the House, really kind of took the reins.
sentences.zh: 于是，众议院议长南希·佩洛西真正接过了指挥棒。

sentences.en: And after the president kind of deputized Steven Mnuchin, the Treasury Secretary, to do the negotiating on behalf of the administration.
sentences.zh: 此前总统指派财政部长史蒂文·姆努钦代表政府进行谈判。

sentences.en: And the negotiations are going very well.
sentences.zh: 谈判进展非常顺利。

sentences.en: This has been a bipartisan effort.
sentences.zh: 这是一次两党合作的努力。

sentences.en: The two of them, who actually have a pretty good working relationship, just started negotiating this
sentences.zh: 他们两人实际上有着相当不错的工作关系，刚开始就这一规模大得多的方案进行谈判，旨在为受此次危机影响的美国人编织一张更强大的社会安全网。

sentences.en: much, much larger package of ways of knitting together a stronger social safety net for Americans who were going to be impacted by this crisis.
sentences.zh: 旨在为受此次危机影响的美国人编织一张更强大的社会安全网。

sentences.en: But we thought it would be important to show the American people, to assure the American people, that we are willing and able to work together to get a job done for them.
sentences.zh: 但我们认为，向美国人民展示并让他们确信，我们愿意且有能力共同努力为他们完成工作，这一点很重要。

sentences.en: And there seemed to be an understanding that as long as that negotiation could stay on track, that relationship could remain intact, that this was going to be workable.
sentences.zh: 似乎有一种共识，只要谈判能保持轨道，那种关系能保持完整，这件事就是可行的。

sentences.en: And it was extraordinary, but it was also an extraordinary set of circumstances.
sentences.zh: 这非常了不起，但这也是一套非同寻常的情况。

sentences.en: And I think there was a general feeling that the scope of this crisis was so large and that the
sentences.zh: 我认为人们普遍感到，这场危机的规模如此之大，对每个人的经济影响如此显著，以至于人们必须放下平时的政治原则来完成这项工作。

sentences.en: economic impact on everyone was so pronounced that people were going to have to put their usual political principles aside to get something done here.
sentences.zh: 以至于人们必须放下平时的政治原则来完成这项工作。

sentences.en: And so that bill passes early in the morning of March 14th, a Saturday morning just before the House went out of session.
sentences.zh: 于是该法案在3月14日清晨通过，那是在众议院休会前的周六早上。

sentences.en: They still don't know the actual size of that package.
sentences.zh: 他们当时甚至不知道该方案的实际规模。

sentences.en: It was in the hundreds of billions of dollars, but they didn't have time to tally the cost before passing it.
sentences.zh: 金额高达数千亿美元，但他们在通过前没有时间统计成本。

sentences.en: But that was a very large vote of support.
sentences.zh: 但那是一次非常强有力的支持投票。

sentences.en: They had only 40 Republicans voting no in the House.
sentences.zh: 众议院只有40名共和党人投了反对票。

sentences.en: So in the end, what kind of paid leave was created by this bill?
sentences.zh: 那么最终，这项法案创造了什么样的带薪休假？

sentences.en: I mean, for the average American who gets sick or has a relative or child to get sick, how many days off paid by the federal government will they have?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，对于生病或有亲属或孩子生病的普通美国人来说，他们将获得多少天由联邦政府支付的假期？

sentences.en: So under this legislation, most workers at small and kind of mid-sized companies would get
sentences.zh: 根据这项立法，大多数中小型公司的员工如果生病、被隔离、正在接受新冠病毒检测，或者正在照顾生病的家庭成员，将获得两周的带薪病假。

sentences.en: two weeks of paid sick leave if they were sick, if they were quarantined, if they were trying to
sentences.zh: 两周的带薪病假，如果他们生病了，如果他们被隔离了，如果他们正在尝试

sentences.en: get tested to see if they had coronavirus or if they were caring for a sick family member.
sentences.zh: 接受检测以查看是否感染了新冠病毒，或者如果他们正在照顾生病的家庭成员。

sentences.en: And then they would get 12 weeks of paid leave if people were caring for children, if their schools were
sentences.zh: 然后，如果人们因为学校关闭，或者他们的日托中心或其他儿童保育提供者无法提供服务而需要照顾孩子，他们将获得12周的带薪假。

sentences.en: closed, or if their daycare or their other child care provider was not available.
sentences.zh: 或者如果他们的日托中心或其他儿童保育提供者无法提供服务。

sentences.en: That's pretty meaningful.
sentences.zh: 这非常有意义。

sentences.en: It's very meaningful.
sentences.zh: 非常有意义。

sentences.en: And it's the first time that there was a federally mandated paid leave benefit.
sentences.zh: 这是第一次有联邦强制规定的带薪休假福利。

sentences.en: And one of the significant things was that it applied not just to regular workers, but people who don't typically get paid leave, like part-time workers, the gig economy
sentences.zh: 其中一个重要之处在于，它不仅适用于普通员工，也适用于通常没有带薪休假的群体，比如兼职员工、零工经济从业者等。

sentences.en: workers, things like that.
sentences.zh: 从业者等。

sentences.en: And Democrats did fight pretty hard to get a more expansive benefit, but Republicans really pushed back.
sentences.zh: 民主党人确实努力争取了更广泛的福利，但共和党人进行了强力抵制。

sentences.en: And so in the end, this was the compromise that they came to.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，这就是他们达成的妥协。

sentences.en: And that brings us to the third bill, the one that Congress is debating today on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了第三项法案，也就是国会今天（周三）正在辩论的那一项。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The entire time that Congress is debating this phase two package, it's clear to everyone that they're going to need to come back, not just with relief to Americans who are hurting,
sentences.zh: 在国会辩论第二阶段方案的整个过程中，每个人都很清楚，他们不仅需要为受苦的美国人提供救济，还需要采取更大规模的应对措施来稳定经济，因为经济实际上为了应对大流行而不得不几乎完全停摆。

sentences.en: but with a much, much larger response to stabilize the economy as it's essentially having to shut down almost entirely to respond to the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 因为经济实际上为了应对大流行而不得不几乎完全停摆。

sentences.en: And so the administration came forward with an $850 billion proposal that included large amounts of money for distressed businesses, big and small loans
sentences.zh: 因此，政府提出了一项8500亿美元的提案，其中包括为陷入困境的企业提供大量资金，为支撑公司、支撑构成经济支柱的大型企业提供大额贷款，

sentences.en: to prop up companies, prop up big corporations that form the backbone of the economy and a much
sentences.zh: 支撑构成经济支柱的大型企业，以及一个规模大得多的失业保险计划，

sentences.en: larger unemployment insurance program to cover people who essentially lost jobs for long periods of time, given the economic downturn.
sentences.zh: 以覆盖那些因经济衰退而长期失业的人。

sentences.en: So this is kind of a classic, large-scale stimulus program.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种经典的、大规模的刺激计划。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so as the scope of the problem becomes larger, as the estimates of how much this is going to cost grow, $850 billion quickly becomes a trillion.
sentences.zh: 随着问题的范围扩大，随着对成本估算的增加，8500亿美元很快就变成了一万亿。

sentences.en: This proposal that's taking shape in Congress gets larger and larger.
sentences.zh: 国会中正在形成的这项提案规模越来越大。

sentences.en: And that's when this whole spirit of comedy and let's put our politics aside and get this done quickly starts to fade away.
sentences.zh: 也就是在那时，那种团结一致、放下政治分歧并迅速完成任务的精神开始消退。

sentences.en: And why is that?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Since the first two bills seem to sail through.
sentences.zh: 因为前两项法案似乎顺利通过了。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, when you're talking about injecting a trillion dollars or more into the economy,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，当你谈论向经济注入一万亿美元或更多资金时，共和党人和民主党人对于如何做到这一点有非常不同的想法。

sentences.en: you have very different ideas among Republicans and Democrats about how best to do that.
sentences.zh: 共和党人和民主党人对于如何做到这一点有非常不同的想法。

sentences.en: And so the ideological differences become a lot sharper.
sentences.zh: 因此，意识形态上的分歧变得更加尖锐。

sentences.en: And hanging over all of this is the memory of the last time the government tried to put together a really aggressive stimulus program and government
sentences.zh: 笼罩在这一切之上的，是2008年金融危机期间，政府上一次试图为陷入困境的公司制定一项真正激进的刺激计划和政府援助计划的记忆。

sentences.en: aid program for distressed companies in 2008 during the financial meltdown.
sentences.zh: 政府援助计划。

sentences.en: And it was the same sort of crisis atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 当时也是同样的危机氛围。

sentences.en: The global economy was melting down.
sentences.zh: 全球经济正在崩溃。

sentences.en: The market turmoil we are experiencing today poses great risk to U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们今天经历的市场动荡对美国纳税人构成了巨大风险。

sentences.en: taxpayers.
sentences.zh: 纳税人。

sentences.en: You know, the Fed chairman and the Treasury secretary at the time came to Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当时的联储主席和财政部长来到国会山。

sentences.en: The taxpayer already is going to suffer the consequences if things don't work the way they should work.
sentences.zh: 如果事情没有按预期发展，纳税人已经要承担后果了。

sentences.en: And scared the wits out of congressional leaders and essentially told them, if you don't do something big and do something big now, this economy, our economy and the global economy
sentences.zh: 他们把国会领导人吓坏了，基本上告诉他们，如果你们现在不采取重大行动，我们的经济和全球经济就会彻底崩溃。

sentences.en: is going to go, you know, down the drain, essentially.
sentences.zh: 我们的经济和全球经济就会彻底崩溃。

sentences.en: I am convinced that this bold approach will cost American families far less than the alternative, a continuing series of financial institution failures and frozen credit markets,
sentences.zh: 我深信，这种大胆的方法对美国家庭造成的成本远低于替代方案，即一系列持续的金融机构倒闭和信贷市场冻结，导致无法为日常需求和经济扩张提供资金。

sentences.en: unable to fund everyday needs and economic expansion.
sentences.zh: 导致无法为日常需求和经济扩张提供资金。

sentences.en: They really scared them into a really quick and aggressive set of moves.
sentences.zh: 他们确实通过恐吓促使他们采取了一系列非常迅速和激进的行动。

sentences.en: And one of those moves was the $700 billion Wall Street bailout, also known as TARP.
sentences.zh: 其中一项行动就是7000亿美元的华尔街救助计划，也称为 TARP。

sentences.en: And, you know, it was another one of these situations where everyone was scared, everyone was moving quickly, they all were trying to put their politics aside and get this done.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是另一种每个人都感到害怕、每个人都在迅速行动、每个人都试图放下政治分歧并完成任务的情况。

sentences.en: And in the end, they did pass that package.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们确实通过了那个方案。

sentences.en: But for both political parties, both for Republicans and Democrats, they really paid the price.
sentences.zh: 但对于共和党和民主党这两个政党来说，他们确实付出了代价。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, you know, both conservatives and very progressive Democrats felt that that package was
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，保守派和非常进步的民主党人都认为那个方案是一个华尔街方案，是一个优先考虑大企业的方案，

sentences.en: a Wall Street package, was a package that, you know, prioritized big business, which many of these
sentences.zh: 而这些企业中的许多本身就对金融崩溃负有责任，他们拿到了钱，政府基本上救助了他们，

sentences.en: businesses were responsible themselves for the meltdown, that they got paid and essentially the
sentences.zh: 而没有真正帮助在此过程中受到伤害的人。

sentences.en: government bailed them out and then didn't really help the people who got hurt in the process.
sentences.zh: 而没有真正帮助在此过程中受到伤害的人。

sentences.en: And so that whole situation gives rise to the Tea Party.
sentences.zh: 所以整个情况催生了茶党运动。

sentences.en: From Washington, D.C., to Connecticut, to Wisconsin, and all over the country, thousands of people came out to protest government spending.
sentences.zh: 从华盛顿特区到康涅狄格州，再到威斯康星州，全国各地成千上万的人走上街头抗议政府支出。

sentences.en: This anti-government spending movement among Republicans.
sentences.zh: 共和党内部这种反政府支出的运动。

sentences.en: And what are some of the lies and the spending that you have particular problems with?
sentences.zh: 你特别反对哪些谎言和支出？

sentences.en: The bailout.
sentences.zh: 救助计划。

sentences.en: We're tired of the spending, tired of the lies that are going on, and we want to take our country back.
sentences.zh: 我们厌倦了这种支出，厌倦了正在发生的谎言，我们想夺回我们的国家。

sentences.en: And it also gives rise on the left to Occupy Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 它也在左翼催生了“占领华尔街”运动。

sentences.en: This movement of, you know, progressives who felt that, you know, the government had sold out to big business and just was not tending to the needs of working people.
sentences.zh: 这场进步人士的运动认为，政府已经出卖给了大企业，根本没有顾及劳动人民的需求。

sentences.en: Wall Street, it crashes.
sentences.zh: 华尔街，它崩溃了。

sentences.en: And, you know, people starve.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们挨饿。

sentences.en: People lose their jobs, things like that.
sentences.zh: 人们失业，诸如此类。

sentences.en: We're very angry at Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 我们对华尔街非常愤怒。

sentences.en: It's the heart of capitalism, American capitalism especially.
sentences.zh: 这是资本主义的核心，尤其是美国资本主义。

sentences.en: That's why we're here today, at Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天来到华尔街的原因。

sentences.en: And in fact, you could argue that it's still the dominant theme of our political debate today.
sentences.zh: 事实上，你可以说这仍然是我们今天政治辩论的主导主题。

sentences.en: I mean,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，

sentences.en: Donald Trump came to the fore talking about, you know, populist themes and helping the little guy and being anti-establishment.
sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普之所以脱颖而出，是因为他谈论民粹主义主题，帮助小人物，并反对建制派。

sentences.en: And Bernie Sanders on the left being against the big corporations and upending a system that was built for big companies and not for ordinary people.
sentences.zh: 而左翼的伯尼·桑德斯则反对大公司，推翻了一个为大公司而非普通人建立的体系。

sentences.en: And so the reverberations of TARP and that vote and that bailout are still being felt in our politics today.
sentences.zh: 所以 TARP、那次投票和那次救助的余波至今仍在我们政治中感受到。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's hard to think of a single piece of legislation that has so profoundly reshaped
sentences.zh: 很难想到有哪一项立法能如此深刻地重塑美国政治，甚至重塑了那些与政治毫无关联的普通人看待政府的方式。

sentences.en: American politics and even kind of how regular people with no connection to politics view their government.
sentences.zh: 美国政治，甚至重塑了那些与政治毫无关联的普通人看待政府的方式。

sentences.en: And it sounds like you're saying that that is what everyone in Congress is thinking about as they approach a trillion dollar plus piece of legislation that looks
sentences.zh: 听起来你是在说，国会里的每个人在处理这项超过一万亿美元的法案时，都在考虑这个问题，而这项法案看起来

sentences.en: a little bit like what was passed in 2008.
sentences.zh: 有点像2008年通过的那项法案。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's sort of the ultimate cautionary tale for members of both political parties who remember the anger that the bailout of 2008 inspired.
sentences.zh: 对于两党议员来说，这算是一个终极警示故事，因为他们还记得2008年救市计划所引发的愤怒。

sentences.en: So you have two sides of the ideological spectrum who are each worried about the reaction if they do this wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以，意识形态光谱两端的双方都在担心，如果他们做错了，会引发什么样的反应。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需绑定信用卡，你会不会想探索一下《纽约时报》？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序，首月免费。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So, Julie, with the lessons of 2008 on everyone's mind in Congress, how does this debate over phase three, this trillion dollar plus stimulus package start to unfold?
sentences.zh: 那么，朱莉，鉴于国会每个人都记着2008年的教训，关于第三阶段——这项超过一万亿美元的刺激计划——的辩论是如何开始展开的呢？

sentences.en: So Democrats and Republicans quickly agree that they want to do a round of quick infusions of cash to Americans.
sentences.zh: 民主党人和共和党人很快达成一致，他们希望向美国民众进行一轮快速的现金注入。

sentences.en: So they decide that they're going to send checks, direct payments of $1,200 per person
sentences.zh: 于是他们决定发放支票，即每人1200美元的直接付款，

sentences.en: to anyone making up to $75,000 a year and then phasing out until you're not eligible if you make
sentences.zh: 发放对象为年收入不超过75000美元的人，之后金额会递减，如果收入达到

sentences.en: $99,000 or more.
sentences.zh: 99000美元或以上，则不再符合资格。

sentences.en: Republicans, uncharacteristically, are the ones pushing these direct payments.
sentences.zh: 共和党人一反常态，成为了推动这些直接付款的一方。

sentences.en: And Democrats are very much on board with that.
sentences.zh: 而民主党人也非常赞同这一点。

sentences.en: This is really just to get people through the immediate pain of seeing the economy completely shutter.
sentences.zh: 这实际上只是为了帮助人们度过经济完全停摆带来的直接痛苦。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: What else is in the bill?
sentences.zh: 法案里还有什么？

sentences.en: There's also a large unemployment insurance component in the bill where they expand unemployment benefits.
sentences.zh: 法案中还有一个庞大的失业保险部分，他们扩大了失业救济金的范围。

sentences.en: So it applies to freelancers and gig workers and those sorts of people who don't normally benefit from unemployment insurance.
sentences.zh: 因此，它适用于自由职业者、零工经济从业者以及那些通常无法享受失业保险的人群。

sentences.en: And you get an additional 13 weeks and then a three-month expansion of what the benefit is.
sentences.zh: 你可以额外获得13周的救济，并且救济金的额度也有三个月的提升。

sentences.en: You get more money over more weeks.
sentences.zh: 你可以在更长的时间内获得更多的钱。

sentences.en: Essentially, Republicans and
sentences.zh: 本质上，共和党和

sentences.en: Democrats both agree that they had to vastly expand jobless benefits for this next period of time.
sentences.zh: 民主党都同意，他们必须在接下来的这段时间里大幅扩大失业救济。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So what end up being the big sticking points?
sentences.zh: 那么，最终的重大分歧点是什么？

sentences.en: Because you mentioned that when it comes to this piece of the overall package, that the Harmony starts to break down.
sentences.zh: 因为你提到，当谈到整体方案的这一部分时，和谐就开始破裂了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The big sticking point ends up being this $500 billion fund to essentially bail out distressed companies.
sentences.zh: 最终的重大分歧点是这5000亿美元的基金，本质上是为了救助陷入困境的公司。

sentences.en: $75 billion of that would go to specific industries like airlines that are singled out as
sentences.zh: 其中750亿美元将流向特定行业，比如航空公司，它们被单独列出，

sentences.en: sort of singularly affected by this pandemic and had the biggest brunt of the pain early on.
sentences.zh: 因为它们受到这场疫情的独特影响，并且在早期承受了最大的打击。

sentences.en: But the vast majority of that money, the $425 billion would go to the Federal Reserve to essentially cover their
sentences.zh: 但其中绝大部分资金，即4250亿美元，将交给美联储，本质上是为了覆盖他们

sentences.en: losses on a huge new lending program for large categories of distressed businesses who would be
sentences.zh: 为各类陷入困境的大型企业提供的一项庞大新贷款计划的损失，这些企业将

sentences.en: able to receive government credit to basically keep themselves afloat and to keep them in business during the downturn.
sentences.zh: 能够获得政府信贷，从而在经济低迷期间维持生存并继续经营。

sentences.en: So this seems the most like a 2008-style kind of bailout.
sentences.zh: 所以这看起来最像2008年风格的救市。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's just a big pot of money.
sentences.zh: 这只是一大笔钱。

sentences.en: And the Federal Reserve has the ability to make these loans however it sees fit.
sentences.zh: 美联储有权以其认为合适的方式发放这些贷款。

sentences.en: The money goes through the Treasury Department, but in the end, is not really money that Congress can control.
sentences.zh: 资金通过财政部拨付，但最终，这并不是国会真正能控制的钱。

sentences.en: And so this is where the controversy really begins.
sentences.zh: 所以争议也就从这里开始了。

sentences.en: We're not here to create a slush fund for Donald Trump and his family or a slush fund for the
sentences.zh: 我们不是为了给唐纳德·特朗普和他的家人设立一个行贿基金，也不是为了给

sentences.en: Treasury Department to be able to hand out to their friends.
sentences.zh: 财政部设立一个可以分发给他们朋友的行贿基金。

sentences.en: We're here to help workers.
sentences.zh: 我们是为了帮助工人。

sentences.en: Democrats start to call this a slush fund.
sentences.zh: 民主党人开始称这为行贿基金。

sentences.en: $100 billion slush fund for Steve Mnuchin to, you know, hand out loans to corporations as he pleased.
sentences.zh: 给史蒂夫·姆努钦的1000亿美元行贿基金，让他可以随心所欲地向企业发放贷款。

sentences.en: I mean, do Americans think that this man, this man is going to look out for the well-being of working Americans over the well-being of corporations and corporate CEOs?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，美国人会认为这个人会把工薪阶层的福祉置于企业和企业高管的福祉之上吗？

sentences.en: I certainly don't trust him, not without oversight.
sentences.zh: 我当然不信任他，没有监督的话，我绝不信任。

sentences.en: And the slush fund...
sentences.zh: 还有那个行贿基金……

sentences.en: That, you know, this is going to be money that has no strings attached.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这笔钱将没有任何附加条件。

sentences.en: It's a blank check.
sentences.zh: 这是一张空白支票。

sentences.en: They have no oversight over it.
sentences.zh: 他们对此没有任何监督。

sentences.en: They said, no, no, no, no, no, no.
sentences.zh: 他们说，不，不，不，不，不，不。

sentences.en: Like, which companies are getting this money?
sentences.zh: 比如，哪些公司拿到了这笔钱？

sentences.en: What are they doing with it?
sentences.zh: 他们用这些钱做了什么？

sentences.en: How is it being overseen?
sentences.zh: 它是如何被监管的？

sentences.en: We need to require that if you get money through this kind of bailout fund, that there aren't going to be any stock buybacks.
sentences.zh: 我们需要要求，如果你通过这种救市基金获得资金，就不能进行任何股票回购。

sentences.en: The whole time you're getting government assistance, you should not be
sentences.zh: 在你获得政府援助的整个期间，你不应该

sentences.en: enriching yourself at the expense of your workers, at the expense of shareholders.
sentences.zh: 以牺牲工人、牺牲股东为代价来中饱私囊。

sentences.en: And so they start to really push for much stricter conditions on this money.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始真正推动对这笔资金施加更严格的条件。

sentences.en: And it becomes a real bone of contention.
sentences.zh: 这成为了一个真正的争论焦点。

sentences.en: So how does the fight over how this money will be used and overseen, how does that get resolved?
sentences.zh: 那么，关于这笔钱将如何使用和监管的争论是如何解决的呢？

sentences.en: So Democrats start demanding big oversight requirements over this fund.
sentences.zh: 民主党人开始要求对该基金进行严格的监督。

sentences.en: They want to have an inspector general whose job it would be to monitor how this money gets spent, who gets it, how it's used.
sentences.zh: 他们希望设立一名监察长，其职责是监控这笔钱如何支出、谁获得了资金以及如何使用。

sentences.en: They also want to have a panel appointed by themselves, appointed by Congress that would oversee the fund, that would get to see all the records, that would have access to all of
sentences.zh: 他们还希望由他们自己、由国会任命一个小组来监督该基金，该小组将有权查看所有记录，有权获取政府拥有的关于这些公司的所有信息，

sentences.en: the information that the government has about these companies and how they're being helped and what kind of conditions they have agreed to as a term of that help.
sentences.zh: 以及他们是如何得到帮助的，以及他们作为帮助条件同意了什么样的条款。

sentences.en: These are the kind of oversight requirements that Democrats hope will prevent this fund from being regarded in the way that TARP was,
sentences.zh: 这些正是民主党人希望的监督要求，以防止该基金被像TARP那样看待，

sentences.en: that it was some sort of giveaway, no strings attached, that allowed companies to take advantage of government help.
sentences.zh: 即被视为某种无附加条件的赠予，允许公司利用政府的帮助。

sentences.en: Okay, so that's the Democrats' pushback on this fund and on this bill.
sentences.zh: 好的，这就是民主党人对该基金和该法案的抵制。

sentences.en: What is the response from the Republicans?
sentences.zh: 共和党人的回应是什么？

sentences.en: The Republicans are livid.
sentences.zh: 共和党人非常愤怒。

sentences.en: They ought to be embarrassed, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 总统先生，他们应该感到羞愧。

sentences.en: In fact, I've heard from some of them who are embarrassed.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我从他们中的一些人那里听说，他们感到很尴尬。

sentences.en: They feel like they have negotiated in good faith with Democrats over all of these measures.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得自己在所有这些措施上都与民主党进行了真诚的谈判。

sentences.en: We crafted this version of the proposal together.
sentences.zh: 我们共同制定了这个提案版本。

sentences.en: Over the payments to families, over the unemployment insurance expansion.
sentences.zh: 关于给家庭的付款，关于失业保险的扩大。

sentences.en: But yesterday, when the time came to vote on these urgent measures,
sentences.zh: 但昨天，当需要对这些紧急措施进行投票时，

sentences.en: our Democratic colleagues chose to block it.
sentences.zh: 我们的民主党同事选择了阻挠。

sentences.en: They had actually come a fair way toward compromising with Democrats on some of the big things that Democrats cared about, and the Democrats were still holding out for more.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上在民主党关心的一些重大问题上已经向民主党妥协了很多，但民主党人仍然坚持要求更多。

sentences.en: Were Republicans right when they suggested that Democrats had started to try to infuse this third piece of legislation with liberal priorities?
sentences.zh: 当共和党人暗示民主党人开始试图将自由派的优先事项注入这第三部分立法时，他们说对了吗？

sentences.en: I caught Mitch McConnell on the floor giving a speech in which he suggested that all of a sudden things were cropping up in the Democratic version of this bill.
sentences.zh: 我听到米奇·麦康奈尔在议会发言时暗示，民主党版本的法案中突然出现了一些东西。

sentences.en: Tax credits for solar energy and wind energy.
sentences.zh: 太阳能和风能的税收抵免。

sentences.en: Provisions to force employers to give special new treatment to big labor.
sentences.zh: 强迫雇主给予大型工会特殊新待遇的条款。

sentences.en: And listen to this.
sentences.zh: 听听这个。

sentences.en: New emission standards for the airlines.
sentences.zh: 针对航空公司的新的排放标准。

sentences.en: Are you kidding me?
sentences.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: Things that he regarded as just having nothing to do with the pandemic and saving the American economy.
sentences.zh: 他认为这些事情与疫情和拯救美国经济毫无关系。

sentences.en: I'd like to see Senate Democrats tell New York City doctors and nurses who are literally overrun as we speak
sentences.zh: 我想看看参议院的民主党人如何告诉纽约市的医生和护士，他们现在正处于超负荷状态，

sentences.en: that they're filibustering hospital funding and more masks because they want to argue with the airlines over their carbon footprint?
sentences.zh: 却因为想和航空公司争论碳足迹问题，而阻挠医院拨款和更多的口罩？

sentences.en: There was an element of truth to that because in the interim, while Chuck Schumer, the Democratic leader, was negotiating behind the scenes with Mnuchin, the Treasury Secretary,
sentences.zh: 这其中确实有真实成分，因为在此期间，当民主党领袖查克·舒默在幕后与财政部长姆努钦谈判，

sentences.en: to get these last additional concessions to get to a deal,
sentences.zh: 以获得最后的额外让步来达成协议时，

sentences.en: Nancy Pelosi did unveil her own version of a stimulus plan.
sentences.zh: 南希·佩洛西确实公布了她自己的刺激计划版本。

sentences.en: It was a $2.5 trillion bill that had all sorts of Democratic priorities in it because, after all, it is written by House Democrats who control the other chamber.
sentences.zh: 这是一个2.5万亿美元的法案，里面包含了各种民主党的优先事项，因为毕竟，它是控制另一个议院的众议院民主党人写的。

sentences.en: But the reality was, and Senator McConnell clearly knew this, that the real negotiation was going on in the Senate bill.
sentences.zh: 但现实是，麦康奈尔参议员显然知道这一点，真正的谈判是在参议院法案中进行的。

sentences.en: The Senate floor has, at this point, devolved into a real bitter place with a lot of shouting and some profanity that you generally don't hear.
sentences.zh: 参议院议事厅此时已经演变成一个非常痛苦的地方，有很多叫喊声和一些你通常听不到的脏话。

sentences.en: Really?
sentences.zh: 真的吗？

sentences.en: From the normally courtly Senate.
sentences.zh: 来自通常彬彬有礼的参议院。

sentences.en: And part of the issue for Republicans who are in the majority is that their numbers are dwindling.
sentences.zh: 对于占多数的共和党人来说，问题的一部分是他们的人数正在减少。

sentences.en: Because by Sunday...
sentences.zh: 因为到了周日……

sentences.en: Breaking headline on Capitol Hill,
sentences.zh: 国会山突发头条新闻，

sentences.en: Senator Rand Paul testing positive for the coronavirus as Congress negotiates that massive stimulus package.
sentences.zh: 兰德·保罗参议员在国会就大规模刺激计划进行谈判时，新冠病毒检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: They have learned that Rand Paul of Kentucky has tested positive for COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 他们得知肯塔基州的兰德·保罗新冠病毒检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He's the first senator to do so.
sentences.zh: 他是第一位这样做的参议员。

sentences.en: You were all at lunch together on Friday.
sentences.zh: 你们周五都在一起吃午饭。

sentences.en: Yes, yes, we're at lunch together with Rand and hope he's doing very well.
sentences.zh: 是的，是的，我们和兰德一起吃午饭，希望他一切都好。

sentences.en: But we have to determine whether any of us should self-quarantine as a result of being in the same room.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须确定我们中是否有人因为在同一个房间而需要自我隔离。

sentences.en: And then two other Republicans who had been in close contact with him go into quarantine themselves out of an abundance of caution.
sentences.zh: 随后，另外两名与他有过密切接触的共和党人出于谨慎考虑，也进行了自我隔离。

sentences.en: They already have two members who had already isolated themselves because they had been exposed to someone who later tested positive.
sentences.zh: 他们已经有两名成员因为接触过后来检测呈阳性的人而进行了自我隔离。

sentences.en: And so their numbers are dwindling.
sentences.zh: 所以他们的人数正在减少。

sentences.en: And there's really not much they can do to force Democrats to go along until they have gotten their concerns met.
sentences.zh: 在他们的担忧得到满足之前，他们真的没有什么办法能强迫民主党人配合。

sentences.en: So with all of that pressure building behind this negotiation,
sentences.zh: 因此，随着谈判背后的压力不断增加，

sentences.en: late Tuesday night, early Wednesday morning, the White House and Republicans finally make the deal with Democrats.
sentences.zh: 周二深夜到周三凌晨，白宫和共和党人终于与民主党人达成了协议。

sentences.en: They give them what they want on oversight.
sentences.zh: 他们在监督问题上给了民主党人他们想要的。

sentences.en: And the two sides come together on a compromise.
sentences.zh: 双方达成妥协。

sentences.en: And by Wednesday afternoon, they are on a glide path, it looks like, to pass it in the Senate.
sentences.zh: 到周三下午，看起来他们已经走上了在参议院通过该法案的顺风车。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's around 3.15 on Wednesday afternoon.
sentences.zh: 所以现在是周三下午3点15分左右。

sentences.en: And it sounds, from what you're saying, like this bill is about to get adopted.
sentences.zh: 听你这么说，好像这项法案马上就要通过了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Senate is planning later today, they're hoping to pass this.
sentences.zh: 参议院计划今天晚些时候通过这项法案。

sentences.en: And then it would go to the House
sentences.zh: 然后它会提交给众议院，

sentences.en: and get a vote in the House on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 并在周四在众议院进行投票。

sentences.en: Julie, as best you can tell,
sentences.zh: 朱莉，据你所知，

sentences.en: given the oversight that Democrats won from Republicans, is this bill crafted in a way that will safeguard against the kind of public outrage and the long-lasting political fallout
sentences.zh: 考虑到民主党从共和党那里赢得的监督权，这项法案的制定方式是否能防止美国在2008年救市后经历的那种公众愤怒和长期的政治后果？

sentences.en: that America experienced after that 2008 bailout?
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们真的不知道。

sentences.en: I don't think we really know.
sentences.zh: 这个基金的规模如此之大，以至于很难预测它将如何影响经济，如何影响普通民众，

sentences.en: The size of this fund is so large that it's really hard to predict how it's going to impact the economy, how it's going to impact ordinary people,
sentences.zh: 以及可能产生的政治后果是什么。

sentences.en: and what the political fallout might be.
sentences.zh: 我认为国会议员和政府官员只是希望他们已经实施了一些有效的东西。

sentences.en: I think members of Congress and folks in the administration are just hoping that they have put in place something that will be effective.
sentences.zh: 但我认为没人真正知道。

sentences.en: But I don't think anyone really knows.
sentences.zh: 回到你刚才用的那个词“有效”，有没有关于这项近2万亿美元的刺激法案实际上能刺激美国经济多久的预测，

sentences.en: To go back to that word you just used, effective, is there a prediction of how long this nearly $2 trillion stimulus bill will actually stimulate the American economy,
sentences.zh: 在这场疫情中，它能为美国经济争取多少时间？

sentences.en: how much time it's going to buy the United States economy in the middle of this pandemic?
sentences.zh: 我认为人们对这个问题有很多担忧。

sentences.en: I think there's a lot of concern about that question.
sentences.zh: 这并不是市场上的一个小插曲，可以迅速纠正然后继续前进。

sentences.en: This is not sort of a blip in the markets that can be quickly rectified and we move on.
sentences.zh: 人们不知道公司会停业多久。

sentences.en: People don't know how long companies will be shuttered for.
sentences.zh: 目前还不清楚工人们会受到多长时间的影响，以及在此过程中可能被裁减的一些工作岗位是否还会回来。

sentences.en: It's unclear how long workers will be impacted and whether some of these jobs that may be eliminated in the process are even ever going to come back.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为现在真正的问题不仅是这笔钱能支撑经济多久，而是下一阶段会是什么样子？

sentences.en: So I think the real question now is not only how long will this last the economy, but what does the next phase look like?
sentences.zh: 因为国会山上的每个人都认识到，这不会是他们必须通过的最后一项经济措施。

sentences.en: Because everybody on Capitol Hill recognizes that this is not going to be the last economic measure they're going to have to pass.
sentences.zh: 他们已经在讨论第四阶段，以及需要什么才能让事情在未来的几个月里保持稳定状态。

sentences.en: They're already talking about a phase four and what's going to be needed just to, you know, keep things at steady state for months and months to come.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这项2万亿美元的刺激计划只是可能最终成为另一套数万亿美元刺激计划的开始。

sentences.en: In other words, this $2 trillion stimulus package is just the beginning of what may end up being another set of multi-trillion dollar stimulus packages.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 我不认为有人真正知道应对我们目前所面临的情况到底需要多大的规模。

sentences.en: I don't think that anybody really knows the full scope of what's going to be needed to respond to what we're facing right now.
sentences.zh: 朱莉，我想谈论国债从来都不是一个好时机，但它已经达到了23万亿美元。

sentences.en: Julie, it never feels like a good time to talk about the national debt, I suppose, but it is already $23 trillion.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚去查了一下。

sentences.en: I just went and checked.
sentences.zh: 而且在特朗普政府领导下，它一直在稳步增长。

sentences.en: And it's been on a very steady increase under the Trump administration.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: How exactly is Congress planning to pay for all of this?
sentences.zh: 国会究竟打算如何为这一切买单？

sentences.en: What's astonishing about this is that, you know, the vast majority of it is going to be financed by government borrowing for the foreseeable future.
sentences.zh: 令人震惊的是，在可预见的未来，这笔开支绝大部分将通过政府借贷来筹措。

sentences.en: And that is something that many members of both parties have long been concerned about, but it is not something that anyone is questioning right now.
sentences.zh: 这曾是两党许多议员长期担忧的问题，但目前却无人对此提出质疑。

sentences.en: I think the thought is that this response needs to be as huge and aggressive as it possibly can be.
sentences.zh: 我想大家的想法是，这次的应对措施必须尽可能地宏大且强力。

sentences.en: And those considerations, you know, not that they were really top of mind for anyone in Congress for a long time now, as you well know,
sentences.zh: 正如你所知，这些考量在国会很长一段时间里并非大家关注的重点，

sentences.en: but anyone who was concerned about those things seems to be putting them aside for now, given what we're facing.
sentences.zh: 但鉴于我们目前所面临的局面，任何曾经担忧这些问题的人似乎都暂时将其搁置了。

sentences.en: Thank you, Julie.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，朱莉。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On this vote, the yeas are 96,
sentences.zh: 本次投票结果为：赞成票96张，

sentences.en: the nays are zero, the 60-vote threshold having been achieved, the bill is passed.
sentences.zh: 反对票0张，已达到60票的门槛，法案通过。

sentences.en: Late Wednesday night, the Senate passed the stimulus bill with overwhelming bipartisan support.
sentences.zh: 周三深夜，参议院以压倒性的两党支持通过了这项刺激法案。

sentences.en: There are millions of Americans watching us right now at home on their televisions, separated from friends and family, fearful for their children and their livelihoods,
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，有数百万美国民众正守在电视机前，他们与亲友隔离，为孩子和生计感到担忧，

sentences.en: unsure of when the time will come when all of our lives may return to normal.
sentences.zh: 不确定我们的生活何时才能恢复正常。

sentences.en: In a speech from the Senate floor,
sentences.zh: 在参议院的发言中，

sentences.en: Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer called it historic legislation to match a historic crisis.
sentences.zh: 参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默称这是一项应对历史性危机的历史性立法。

sentences.en: Let us tell them tonight that help is on the way, that they are not truly alone,
sentences.zh: 让我们今晚告诉他们，援助正在路上，他们并非孤立无援，

sentences.en: that this country, that this Senate, that this government is here for them in a time of dire need.
sentences.zh: 告诉他们，在这个急需帮助的时刻，这个国家、这个参议院、这个政府会与他们同在。

sentences.en: The House is expected to pass the same legislation tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 众议院预计将于明天通过同样的法案。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: The global death toll from the coronavirus surpassed 20,000 people on Wednesday, led by Italy, which reported nearly 700 new deaths.
sentences.zh: 周三，全球新冠病毒死亡人数突破2万人，其中意大利死亡人数最多，报告新增近700例死亡病例。

sentences.en: Five countries now have death tolls over 1,000.
sentences.zh: 目前已有五个国家的死亡人数超过1000人。

sentences.en: Italy, Spain, China, Iran, and France.
sentences.zh: 分别是意大利、西班牙、中国、伊朗和法国。

sentences.en: In the U.S., where the death toll approached 1,000, disruptions from the virus deepened.
sentences.zh: 在美国，死亡人数接近1000人，病毒造成的社会动荡进一步加剧。

sentences.en: We're going to limit movement outside the homes beyond essential needs, effective Friday, March 27th, at 11.59 p.m.
sentences.zh: 除必要需求外，我们将限制民众外出，该规定自3月27日周五晚11点59分起生效，

sentences.en: to Friday, April 10th.
sentences.zh: 持续至4月10日周五。

sentences.en: And I want to be clear...
sentences.zh: 我想明确一点……

sentences.en: Idaho and Minnesota became the latest states to order residents to stay at home for the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 爱达荷州和明尼苏达州成为最新下令居民在未来几周内居家避疫的州。

sentences.en: We have weighed out the variables here.
sentences.zh: 我们已经权衡了其中的各种变量。

sentences.en: We believe at this point in time, as of today, that buys us enough time.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，就目前而言，这为我们争取到了足够的时间。

sentences.en: We may ask...
sentences.zh: 我们可能会要求……

sentences.en: Meanwhile, school districts across the country, from California to Connecticut, extended their closures through at least the end of April to limit transmissions.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，从加利福尼亚州到康涅狄格州，全国各地的学区为了限制病毒传播，将停课时间至少延长到了四月底。

sentences.en: Teachers, districts, and parents are getting creative and doing everything they can to ensure that their kids don't fall behind and that they stay engaged.
sentences.zh: 教师、学区和家长们正在发挥创意，尽其所能确保孩子们不会掉队，并保持学习状态。

sentences.en: In Massachusetts,
sentences.zh: 在马萨诸塞州，

sentences.en: Governor Charlie Baker said he recognized the hardship that the closures have imposed on everyone involved.
sentences.zh: 州长查理·贝克表示，他理解停课给所有相关人员带来的困难。

sentences.en: On behalf of all of us, I just want to say thank you because this matters.
sentences.zh: 我谨代表我们所有人说一声谢谢，因为这非常重要。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，

sentences.en: when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却最终失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》节目。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在各大播客平台收听。
